title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 2,601–2,650 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

examples.en: Corporate sustainability reports outline eco-friendly business goals.
examples.zh: 企業永續發展報告書詳述了公司邁向環保營運的各項目標。

examples.en: Promoting agricultural sustainability ensures that future generations will have fertile soil.
examples.zh: 推廣農業永續經營能確保未來的子孫後代依然擁有肥沃富饒的土地。

examples.en: The city's sustainability plan focuses on reducing municipal landfill waste.
examples.zh: 這座城市的永續發展藍圖重點聚焦於大幅削減市政垃圾掩埋總量。

examples.en: Utilizing solar energy is a sustainable way to power urban transportation.
examples.zh: 運用太陽能發電是一種兼顧環保與永續的都會大眾運輸供電方式。

examples.en: Consumers increasingly prefer sustainable fashion made from organic and recycled fibers.
examples.zh: 現代消費者日益青睞採用有機與再生回收纖維製成的永續時尚服飾。

examples.en: Overfishing threatens the survival of fish populations and prevents sustainable marine harvests.
examples.zh: 過度濫捕威脅著魚群的繁衍生存，並嚴重阻礙了海洋資源的可持續採捕。

examples.en: Commuting by YouBike significantly lowers your daily carbon footprint.
examples.zh: 騎乘 YouBike 公共自行車通勤能顯著減少您每日的碳足跡。

examples.en: Many food manufacturers now print a certified carbon footprint label on their packages.
examples.zh: 許多食品製造大廠如今在產品外包裝上清楚標示經過認證的碳足跡標籤。

examples.en: Installing solar panels on your rooftop can dramatically reduce your household carbon footprint.
examples.zh: 在居家屋頂上安裝太陽能光電板，能夠戲劇性地大幅降低您的家戶碳足跡。

examples.en: Leading tech giants pledge to make all manufacturing carbon neutral by 2030.
examples.zh: 頂尖科技巨頭承諾在 2030 年前讓旗下所有製造工廠達成碳中和。

examples.en: The university designed a carbon neutral library powered entirely by geothermal and solar energy.
examples.zh: 這所大學規劃設計了一棟完全由地熱與太陽能供電的零碳中和圖書館。

examples.en: Purchasing verified carbon offsets helps commercial airlines offer carbon neutral flights.
examples.zh: 購買經過第三方認證的碳權抵換，有助於民航航空公司推出碳中和綠色航班。

examples.en: Taiwan set ambitious milestones to transition toward net-zero emissions by 2050.
examples.zh: 台灣設立了雄心勃勃的政策目標，期盼在 2050 年達成淨零碳排。

examples.en: Achieving net-zero requires massive investments in carbon capture technology and clean energy.
examples.zh: 達成淨零轉型需要對碳捕捉封存技術與乾淨清潔能源進行規模龐大的資金投資。

examples.en: The newly constructed office tower was engineered to meet net-zero carbon building standards.
examples.zh: 這棟剛竣工的現代化企業辦公大樓完全按照淨零碳建築的嚴苛標準進行規劃設計。

examples.en: Burning fossil fuels releases massive amounts of greenhouse gases (GHG).
examples.zh: 燃燒石化燃料會釋放出巨量加劇氣候變遷的溫室氣體。

examples.en: Governments are negotiating binding international targets to slash industrial greenhouse gas emissions.
examples.zh: 各國政府正在多邊談判中積極制定具法律約束力的工業溫室氣體減排硬指標。

examples.en: Methane emitted from livestock farming is an extremely potent greenhouse gas.
examples.zh: 畜牧業反芻牲畜所排出的甲烷氣體，是一種溫室效應極其強烈的溫室氣體。

examples.en: Global warming causes rising sea levels and more intense typhoons.
examples.zh: 全球暖化導致全球海平面加速上升，並誘發更具破壞力的強烈颱風。

examples.en: The rapid retreat of polar glaciers provides undeniable scientific evidence of global warming.
examples.zh: 極地冰川與高山冰原的急速消退，為全球暖化現象提供了不可否認的科學鐵證。

examples.en: Scientists warn that global warming could cause severe droughts in subtropical agricultural regions.
examples.zh: 氣候科學家提出嚴正警告，全球暖化恐將在亞熱帶主要農業產區誘發罕見的持久大旱。

examples.en: International summits unite world leaders to tackle catastrophic climate change.
examples.zh: 聯合國國際氣候峰會凝聚各國領袖共識以積極應對氣候變遷危機。

examples.en: Farmers in central Taiwan adjust planting seasons in response to erratic climate change.
examples.zh: 台灣中部的廣大農民積極調整傳統播種插秧農期，以從容應對捉摸不定的氣候變遷。

examples.en: Protecting mangrove swamps helps coastal communities withstand severe storms triggered by climate change.
examples.zh: 積極復育沿海紅樹林濕地，能協助濱海村落抵禦由氣候變遷所引發的狂暴風暴侵襲。

examples.en: The circular economy promotes repairing, remanufacturing, and recycling resources.
examples.zh: 循環經濟倡導產品維修保養、再製造與資源全面循環回收利用。

examples.en: By turning agricultural waste into bio-plastics, the factory embraces the circular economy model.
examples.zh: 透過將農業農廢殘渣提煉轉化為生物可分解塑膠，該工廠深耕落實了循環經濟模式。

examples.en: A successful circular economy minimizes reliance on newly extracted raw mineral resources.
examples.zh: 健全成功的循環經濟體系能將產業對新開採天然礦物原物料的過度依賴降至最低。

examples.en: Investing in renewable energy reduces dependence on imported fossil coal.
examples.zh: 大力投資再生能源可有效降低對進口化石燃煤發電的過度依賴。

examples.en: Offshore wind and rooftop solar are the cornerstones of Taiwan's renewable energy development.
examples.zh: 離岸風電與家戶屋頂型太陽能是台灣推動綠色再生能源發展最核心的兩大基石。

examples.en: Technological breakthroughs in battery storage have made renewable energy far more reliable.
examples.zh: 大容量儲能電池領域的關鍵技術突破，使得綠色再生能源的供電穩定性大幅提升。

examples.en: Rooftop solar power panels convert bright Taiwanese sunshine into electricity.
examples.zh: 屋頂太陽能光電板將台灣充沛燦爛的陽光轉化為乾淨綠電。

examples.en: The remote mountain monitoring station is powered entirely by independent solar power units.
examples.zh: 這座偏遠的高山水文氣象監測站完全由獨立運作的太陽能光電儲能系統供應電力。

examples.en: Subsidies encouraged rural farmers to install solar power collectors on their warehouse roofs.
examples.zh: 政府專案補助鼓勵農村農民在閒置農機倉庫屋頂鋪設太陽能發電集光板以售電增收。

examples.en: Giant offshore wind turbines spin gracefully along the western coast.
examples.zh: 沿著台灣西海岸海面上，巨型離岸風力發電機正優雅迎風運轉。

examples.en: Modern wind turbines can generate clean electricity even under gentle sea breezes.
examples.zh: 現代化先進風力發電機技術精良，即便在微弱徐緩的海風吹拂下亦能穩定輸出潔淨電力。

examples.en: Routine maintenance ensures that offshore wind turbines can survive powerful seasonal typhoons.
examples.zh: 嚴謹的定期海上檢修維護，確保了這些離岸風機能在夏季強烈颱風的狂風巨浪中安然無恙。

examples.en: Volcanic heat in Datun provides abundant geothermal energy potential.
examples.zh: 大屯火山群蘊含的豐富地熱為發展地熱發電提供了絕佳潛力。

examples.en: Unlike intermittent solar and wind, geothermal energy provides reliable round-the-clock baseload power.
examples.zh: 與間歇性的太陽能或風力不同，地熱能具備全天候二十四小時不間斷穩定發電的基載優勢。

examples.en: Yilan has successfully developed experimental geothermal energy plants to power local hot spring resorts.
examples.zh: 宜蘭地區近年已成功興建多座示範型地熱發電廠，為鄰近溫泉觀光園區提供零碳電力。

examples.en: Sun Moon Lake pumped-storage hydroelectric plants balance peak electrical demand.
examples.zh: 日月潭抽蓄水力發電廠在用電尖峰時刻發揮關鍵調度平衡功能。

examples.en: The mountain canyon is an ideal geographic location for building a large hydroelectric dam.
examples.zh: 該處陡峭險峻的高山峽谷地形，是築壩興建大型水力發電水庫壩體的絕佳天然地理環境。

examples.en: Hydroelectric power generation produces very low lifecycle greenhouse gas emissions.
examples.zh: 就整體產品生命週期而言，水力發電所產生的溫室氣體碳排總量極低且環境友善。

words.definition: 化石燃料（煤炭、石油、天然氣）

examples.en: Transitioning away from polluting fossil fuels protects the global biosphere.
examples.zh: 逐步汰除高污染的石化燃料發電能有效守護全球生物圈環境。

examples.en: Heavy reliance on imported fossil fuels makes island nations vulnerable to geopolitical crises.
examples.zh: 高度仰賴進口化石燃料發電，使海島型國家在面對國際地緣政治衝突時顯得極其脆弱。

examples.en: Burning fossil fuels like gasoline and diesel releases harmful smog into urban skies.
examples.zh: 汽油與柴油等石化燃料的燃燒排放，在繁華都市上空籠罩了一層危害呼吸道的有害霧霾。

examples.en: Say no to single-use plastic cutlery when ordering takeout lunches.
examples.zh: 訂購外送便當午餐時，請主動勾選不索取一次性塑膠免洗餐具。

examples.en: The municipal government banned single-use paper cups in all government office buildings.
examples.zh: 市政府已明令公告，所屬各級行政機關辦公大樓內全面禁止使用一次性拋棄式紙杯。

examples.en: Hospitals rely on sterile single-use syringes to prevent cross-contamination between patients.
examples.zh: 現代醫療院所仰賴無菌的一次性拋棄式注射針筒，以徹底防止病患之間的交叉感染。

examples.en: Beverage shops comply with the government plastic cup ban by using paper.
examples.zh: 各大手搖飲料店全面配合政府一次用塑膠飲料杯禁令，改用環保紙杯。

examples.en: Environmental activists campaigned for an all-inclusive plastic bag ban across retail supermarkets.
examples.zh: 環保倡議團體長期奔走發起運動，期盼在各大連鎖生鮮超市全面推行購物用塑膠袋禁令。

examples.en: Since the national plastic ban took effect, coastal beach cleanup volunteers have found fewer straws.
examples.zh: 自從全國限塑令正式上路施行以來，參與淨灘活動的志工在海灘上撿到的塑膠吸管大幅減少。

examples.en: Plant-based PLA straws are biodegradable under industrial composting conditions.
examples.zh: 以植物澱粉製成的 PLA 環保吸管在工業堆肥環境下可完全生物分解。

examples.en: Scientists invented a biodegradable packaging film made entirely from discarded crab shells.
examples.zh: 科學家發明了一種完全由廢棄蟹殼幾丁聚醣提煉製成的生物可降解保鮮包裝膜。

examples.en: Unlike synthetic polymers, fallen autumn leaves are fully biodegradable and enrich garden soil.
examples.zh: 與人工合成高分子聚合物不同，秋季飄落的枯葉完全可生物分解，並能深層滋養庭園沃土。

words.definition: 可堆肥降解的；可作堆肥的

examples.en: Food containers made from sugarcane bagasse are 100% compostable.
examples.zh: 採用甘蔗渣植物纖維製成的外帶餐盒具備百分之百可堆肥分解特性。

examples.en: Ensure you throw food scraps into certified compostable bags rather than regular garbage bags.
examples.zh: 請務必確認將日常廚餘剩飯裝入經過認證的可堆肥環保袋中，而非一般不可分解垃圾袋。

examples.en: Compostable tableware breaks down into organic matter within months when buried in damp soil.
examples.zh: 各類可堆肥環保餐具在深埋於濕潤肥沃的土壤後數月內，即可徹底分解轉化為天然腐植質。

examples.en: Plastic bottles take hundreds of years to decompose in natural landfills.
examples.zh: 傳統塑膠寶特瓶在自然掩埋場環境中往往需要數百年才能徹底分解。

examples.en: Fallen tree trunks slowly decompose in old-growth forests, providing nutrients for moss and fungi.
examples.zh: 原始森林中倒下的枯倒巨木隨歲月慢慢腐爛分解，為青苔地衣與野生真菌提供充沛養分。

examples.en: High heat and moisture help bacteria decompose kitchen waste much more rapidly.
examples.zh: 高溫與充足的水氣濕度能顯著活化土壤細菌，進而大幅加速廚餘有機物的生物分解過程。

examples.en: Bringing your own reusable food containers earns dining discounts in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 在台灣自備可重複使用的環保食物保鮮盒外帶餐點常享有折價優惠。

examples.en: Many coffee shops sell lightweight reusable silicone collapsible cups for commuter use.
examples.zh: 許多特色咖啡館推出販售輕巧好收納的可重複使用矽膠折疊杯，深受通勤族喜愛。

examples.en: Replacing disposable diapers with reusable cloth ones saves money and reduces waste.
examples.zh: 改用可重複清洗使用的純棉布尿布取代拋棄式紙尿褲，既經濟節約又能大幅減少垃圾量。

words.definition: 環保隨行杯；保溫隨手杯

examples.en: Carrying a thermal beverage tumbler saves five NTD per drink purchase.
examples.zh: 隨身攜帶環保隨行保溫杯購買外帶手搖飲，每杯可現折五元。

examples.en: She bought a sleek stainless steel tumbler that keeps iced tea cold for twelve hours.
examples.zh: 她精挑細選購買了一個時尚的不鏽鋼隨行保溫杯，能維持冰鎮無糖綠茶長達十二小時保冰。

examples.en: Don't forget to wash your coffee tumbler thoroughly every night to prevent odor buildup.
examples.zh: 每天晚上千萬別忘了將裝過咖啡的隨行杯徹底清洗乾淨，以免杯內殘留頑固茶漬與異味。

words.definition: 環保購物袋；帆布購物袋

examples.en: Keep a foldable eco-bag in your backpack for grocery shopping convenience.
examples.zh: 在隨身背包裡放一個輕巧摺疊環保購物袋，採買生活用品更便利。

examples.en: Department stores hand out branded linen eco-bags as gift rewards for loyal VIP shoppers.
examples.zh: 百貨公司週年慶特別致贈印有品牌燙金標誌的麻質環保購物袋，作為回饋貴賓的專屬好禮。

examples.en: Using a sturdy canvas eco-bag prevents thousands of plastic carrier bags from ending up in oceans.
examples.zh: 養成出門自備耐磨帆布環保購物袋的好習慣，能防止成千上萬的廢塑膠袋流入蔚藍海洋。

words.definition: 零廢棄；零浪費生活哲學

examples.en: The zero waste movement encourages buying unpackaged bulk grains and spices.
examples.zh: 零廢棄生活運動鼓勵民眾前往無包裝商店裸裝採買五穀雜糧與香料。

examples.en: The eco-friendly family adopted a zero waste lifestyle by composting everything and avoiding packaging.
examples.zh: 這個踐行環保的家庭透過落實家戶全堆肥與拒絕所有塑膠包裝，全面擁抱零廢棄生活哲學。

examples.en: Achieving total zero waste is difficult, but taking small sustainable steps makes a huge difference.
examples.zh: 想要做到百分之百的零垃圾雖非易事，但每個人日常邁出的微小永續步伐都能匯聚成巨大改變。

examples.en: Creative designers turn discarded billboard banners into trendy upcycled backpacks.
examples.zh: 創意設計師將退役廢棄的活動廣告帆布升級再造成時尚潮牌後背包。

examples.en: Upcycling transforms unwanted industrial scrap metal into stunning interior sculptures.
examples.zh: 升級再造工藝能化腐朽為神奇，將被棄置的工業金屬廢料轉化為極具視覺震撼的室內雕塑。

examples.en: Unlike basic downcycling, creative upcycling creates items that possess higher artistic value.
examples.zh: 有別於一般的降級回收，發揮巧思的創意升級再造能夠賦予二手廢棄物更高的藝術市場價值。

examples.en: Diligent waste sorting is a deeply ingrained cultural habit across Taiwan.
examples.zh: 嚴謹細緻的垃圾分類是台灣社會高度普及且深植人心的公民美德。

examples.en: Schools conduct regular educational workshops to teach young children proper waste sorting.
examples.zh: 各級中小學定期舉辦校園環保宣導工作坊，從小扎根教育孩童正確的資源垃圾分類要領。

examples.en: Incorrect waste sorting can contaminate entire batches of recyclable plastic bottles.
examples.zh: 錯誤的混雜垃圾分類投放，往往會造成整批原本可回收再利用的塑膠容器受到嚴重油脂污染。

examples.en: Items that cannot be recycled should be placed into general waste bags.
examples.zh: 無法回收再利用的物品應放入政府專用的一般垃圾袋中交由垃圾車清運。

examples.en: Dirty tissues and greasy pizza boxes must be disposed of as general waste.
examples.zh: 擦拭過髒污的衛生紙巾以及沾滿油膩起司的披薩外帶紙盒，均必須按規定歸類為一般垃圾。

examples.en: Residents in Taipei must purchase official blue trash bags to discard general waste.
examples.zh: 台北市市民必須依規定在便利商店購買印有防偽標籤的專用藍色垃圾袋來盛裝一般生活廢棄物。

examples.en: Clean plastic bottles, aluminum cans, and paper are valuable recyclables.
examples.zh: 沖洗乾淨的塑膠瓶、鋁箔罐與廢紙張皆為高價值資源回收物。

examples.en: Please rinse your drink bottles thoroughly before tossing them into the recyclable bin.
examples.zh: 在將各類飲料空瓶投入資源回收桶之前，請務必先用清水徹底將瓶身內部沖洗乾淨。

examples.en: Glass bottles are infinitely recyclable without any loss in pure chemical quality.
examples.zh: 玻璃瓶罐具備近乎可無限次熔融重製循環再利用的物理特性，且化學純度絲毫不會劣化衰退。

examples.en: Kitchen food waste is collected separately to produce organic compost.
examples.zh: 家戶廚房廚餘單獨分類回收後，可用於堆肥發酵製成有機培養土。

examples.en: Restaurants donate unsold edible dishes to charity pantries to eliminate unnecessary food waste.
examples.zh: 許多良心餐飲名店每日將未售出的完好熟食捐贈給慈善食物銀行，以杜絕無謂的剩食廚餘浪費。

examples.en: Throwing away uneaten leftovers represents an enormous waste of water, energy, and money.
examples.zh: 隨意倒掉未吃完的餐盤剩菜，本質上代表著對珍貴水資源、農產人力與家庭荷包的巨大浪費。

examples.en: Recycling diverted tons of solid trash away from overflowing urban landfills.
examples.zh: 全民資源回收讓成千上萬噸固體廢棄物免於堆滿飽和的都市垃圾掩埋場。

examples.en: Decomposing organic matter trapped in underground landfills generates volatile methane gas.
examples.zh: 深埋在地下掩埋場中封閉厭氧分解的各類有機質垃圾，會長期蓄積並釋放出易燃的甲烷氣體。

examples.en: The municipality converted the abandoned suburban landfill into a blooming ecological public park.
examples.zh: 市政府發揮巧思進行土地復育，將這座早已封場廢棄的郊區垃圾掩埋場改造成百花齊放的生態公園。

examples.en: Modern waste incinerators generate electricity through waste-to-energy systems.
examples.zh: 現代化大型垃圾焚化廠透過廢棄物轉化能源技術發電回饋電網。

examples.en: Strict emission scrubbers prevent toxic dioxins from escaping the chimney of the municipal incinerator.
examples.zh: 煙囪頂端加裝的高效洗滌除塵設備，嚴密防止劇毒戴奧辛氣體從市政焚化爐煙囪排入大氣。

examples.en: Taiwan's Beitou incinerator features a famous rotating restaurant atop its tall smokestack.
examples.zh: 台灣知名的台北北投垃圾焚化廠別具特色，其高聳彩繪煙囪頂部設有一座極負盛名的景觀旋轉餐廳。

examples.en: Water conservation habits like short showers help during dry spring seasons.
examples.zh: 養成縮減淋浴時間等節約用水好習慣能安度春季乾旱枯水期。

examples.en: Wildlife conservation groups work around the clock to protect green sea turtle nesting grounds.
examples.zh: 野生動植物保育民間團體日以繼夜全力奔走，悉心守護綠蠵龜在離島沙灘上的產卵棲地。

examples.en: The national park enforces strict environmental conservation regulations to keep the alpine forest pristine.
examples.zh: 國家公園依法嚴格執行各項自然環境資源保育法令規章，竭力維護這片高山冷溫帶原始林的純淨。

examples.en: Electric vehicles produce zero tailpipe exhaust emissions in crowded cities.
examples.zh: 純電動車在擁擠繁華的都會區中行駛時達到零廢氣尾氣排放。

examples.en: Government subsidies and tax incentives motivate taxi fleets to transition to electric vehicles.
examples.zh: 政府祭出高額購車補助款與各項稅捐減免誘因，積極鼓勵廣大計程車車隊全面汰換升級為電動車。

examples.en: Developing longer-lasting batteries is crucial for accelerating the worldwide adoption of electric vehicles.
examples.zh: 研發具備更長續航里程與更長使用壽命的動力電池，是加速推動全球電動車普及化的關鍵核心。

words.definition: 電池交換系統；換電模式

examples.en: Scooter riders enjoy six-second battery swapping at thousands of urban stations.
examples.zh: 電動機車騎士在全台數千座換電站享受六秒快速抽換電池的極致便利。

examples.en: The network operator deployed intelligent battery swapping cabinets outside convenience stores and metro stops.
examples.zh: 營運商在全台各大便利超商門市與捷運站出口外，廣泛佈設智慧化公眾換電櫃機組。

examples.en: Fast battery swapping eliminates range anxiety for food delivery couriers who ride all day.
examples.zh: 迅捷無比的快速換電服務，徹底消除了整天在外奔波送餐的外送快遞員對電池續航力竭的焦慮。

examples.en: Highways and department stores install fast DC charging stations for EVs.
examples.zh: 國道高速公路服務區與各大百貨公司普遍廣設電動車直流快充站。

examples.en: The smartphone app directs drivers to the nearest unoccupied electric vehicle charging station.
examples.zh: 智慧手機專屬 App 能精準導航電動車駕駛前往周邊距離最近且目前尚有空位的充電站。

examples.en: Expanding the public charging station infrastructure encourages more drivers to go electric.
examples.zh: 持續擴建公有路邊與公共停車場充電樁基礎設施，能吸引帶動更多傳統車主毅然換開純電動車。

examples.en: Taiwan's dense mountainous terrain supports astonishing biological diversity (biodiversity).
examples.zh: 台灣高聳綿延的高山地形孕育出令人驚嘆的豐富生物多樣性。

examples.en: Deforestation in the Amazon rainforest causes an alarming irreversible collapse in biodiversity.
examples.zh: 亞馬遜熱帶雨林遭到非法大肆砍伐，引發了全球生物多樣性令人心驚且不可逆轉的急劇崩解。

examples.en: Preserving coastal coral reefs is essential because they host tremendous marine biodiversity.
examples.zh: 傾力維護沿海珊瑚礁群落至關重要，因為它們孕育並庇護著海洋中極其繁茂驚人的生物多樣性。

examples.en: Mangrove wetland ecosystems protect coastlines against tidal storm surges.
examples.zh: 紅樹林濕地生態系能有效保護海岸線、阻擋暴潮對陸地的侵蝕。

examples.en: Introducing invasive alien species can cause catastrophic collapse to a fragile local ecosystem.
examples.zh: 貿然引進強勢外來物種往往會對脆弱封閉的本土原生物種生態系統帶來滅頂之災。

examples.en: Every living creature plays an irreplaceable ecological role within this delicate forest ecosystem.
examples.zh: 每一個棲息繁衍的生命個體，在這座精緻微妙的森林生態系統中皆發揮著不可替代的生態功能。

examples.en: National parks serve as protected ecological sanctuaries for pristine wildlife.
examples.zh: 國家公園扮演著守護原始未受破壞野生動植物的自然生態庇護所。

examples.en: Strict international treaties prohibit the cross-border smuggling of endangered wildlife products.
examples.zh: 嚴格的國際多邊公約明令重罰各類瀕危野生動植物活體與副產物的跨國非法走私買賣。

examples.en: Hikers are instructed to store all food in bear-proof canisters to avoid disturbing local wildlife.
examples.zh: 國家公園巡山員宣導登山客務必將隨身口糧裝入防熊密封罐中，以避免滋擾高山野生動植物。

examples.en: The Formosan black bear and leopard cat are rare endangered species.
examples.zh: 台灣黑熊與石虎皆為極度珍貴稀有、急需全民保護的瀕危物種。

examples.en: Habitat destruction has pushed several endemic bird varieties onto the endangered list.
examples.zh: 原生棲息地遭受人類開發持續破壞，已將數種台灣特有種鳥類逼入了即將瀕危的危險名單邊緣。

examples.en: International conservation funds provide critical financial support to protect critically endangered rhinos.
examples.zh: 國際野生動物保育基金會提供至關重要的專案資金挹注，全力救援處於極度瀕危狀態的珍稀犀牛。

words.definition: 物種；生物種類（單複同形）

examples.en: Over six hundred distinct bird species have been recorded in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 在台灣全島已被正式記錄觀察到的野生鳥類物種超過六百種之多。

examples.en: Genetic scientists mapped the complete genome of this rare aquatic species.
examples.zh: 遺傳學家歷經多年努力，終於成功完整繪製出這種稀有水生物種的全基因組圖譜。

examples.en: Several unique insect species exist exclusively in the high-altitude cloud forests of Taiwan.
examples.zh: 有數種極具演化代表性的特有昆蟲物種，僅唯一生活在台灣中高海拔雲霧繚繞的山林之中。

examples.en: Road building can fragment forest habitats, threatening wild animals.
examples.zh: 道路開闢工程可能導致森林棲地破碎化，對野生動物生存造成威脅。

examples.en: The wetland nature reserve provides an undisturbed winter habitat for thousands of migrating black-faced spoonbills.
examples.zh: 這座濕地自然保護區為數以千計前來過冬的國際嬌客黑面琵鷺，提供了完全不受打擾的越冬棲地。

examples.en: Preserving old dead trees is essential because they offer natural nesting habitats for woodpeckers.
examples.zh: 在林地中妥善保留自然老化的站立枯木至關重要，因為它們是各類啄木鳥最佳的天然築巢棲息所。

examples.en: Mountain reforestation projects prevent landslides during torrential summer typhoons.
examples.zh: 山區植樹造林復育水土保持工程能在夏季強颱暴雨時有效預防土石流。

examples.en: Local volunteers planted native saplings as part of a nationwide coastal reforestation campaign.
examples.zh: 在地熱心志工齊聚海邊親手種下一株株台灣原生樹苗，共襄盛舉參與全國海岸防風林造林復育運動。

examples.en: Decades of steady reforestation helped restore the degraded watershed around the mountain reservoir.
examples.zh: 數十年如一日堅持不懈的高山造林綠化，成功讓這座高山重要蓄水水庫周邊劣化的集水區重現生機。

examples.en: Rising seawater temperatures cause catastrophic coral bleaching in southern waters.
examples.zh: 海水溫度異常上升導致南部與離島海域爆發嚴重的珊瑚白化危機。

examples.en: Divers documented severe coral bleaching along the offshore reefs of Kenting National Park.
examples.zh: 專業潛水員在墾丁國家公園周邊近海珊瑚礁群中，詳實拍攝記錄了大規模白化的沉痛影像。

examples.en: Reducing local water pollution gives coral reefs a fighting chance to recover from coral bleaching.
examples.zh: 大幅減少沿岸陸源廢水污染排放，能為受損的珊瑚礁爭取寶貴喘息生機，從白化浩劫中復原。

examples.en: Scientists found tiny microplastics inside deep ocean marine food chains.
examples.zh: 科學家在深海海洋食物鏈中檢測出微細的塑膠微粒殘留。

examples.en: Washing synthetic clothing sheds invisible microplastics into municipal sewage networks.
examples.zh: 用洗衣機清洗化學合成纖維衣物時，常會脫落肉眼難辨的微塑膠並排入都會生活污水管網。

examples.en: Filter feeders like oysters and clams frequently ingest hazardous airborne and aquatic microplastics.
examples.zh: 牡蠣與文蛤等濾食性海洋貝類生物，極易在濾食海水過程中將有害的微塑膠碎屑吞入體內。

words.definition: 綠色消費；綠色採購理念

examples.en: Green consumerism encourages shoppers to buy carbon-labeled certified items.
examples.zh: 綠色消費主義理念鼓勵消費者優先選購印有碳足跡標籤的環保產品。

examples.en: The rise of green consumerism has driven retailers to eliminate excess plastic wrapping.
examples.zh: 現代綠色消費主義意識的覺醒，有力驅使各大實體零售商積極設法剔除過度浮誇的塑膠包裝。

examples.en: Practicing green consumerism means considering the ethical and ecological impact of every product you buy.
examples.zh: 身體力行踐行綠色消費，意味著在掏錢購買任何商品之前，皆會深思其背後的倫理與生態衝擊。

examples.en: Turning off unused lights and computers is essential for energy conservation.
examples.zh: 隨手關閉閒置未使用的電燈與電腦是落實節能省電的日常基本功。

examples.en: Smart thermostats optimize air conditioning usage in large commercial buildings for energy conservation.
examples.zh: 智慧型恆溫控制器能精準調控大型商用辦公大樓的空調冷房效率，以達到絕佳的節約能源成效。

examples.en: The manufacturing company invested heavily in heat recovery systems to promote factory energy conservation.
examples.zh: 這家製造企業大手筆投資引進工業廢熱回收系統，以全力推動工廠內部的全方位節約能源目標。

examples.en: Stricter emissions standards encourage public transit and electric buses.
examples.zh: 更嚴格的排放法規標準加速推動普及大眾交通工具與電動公車。

examples.en: The power company installed modern filtration scrubbers to reduce sulfur dioxide emissions.
examples.zh: 這家電力公司斥資安裝了先進的化學洗滌過濾器，以有效減少燃煤鍋爐的二氧化硫廢氣排放。

examples.en: Transitioning away from coal power significantly reduced the city's toxic particulate emissions.
examples.zh: 逐步汰換老舊燃煤火力發電廠，顯著大幅降低了這座工業大都會上空的懸浮微粒毒性排放。

examples.en: Air purifiers filter out fine particle pollutants like PM2.5 efficiently.
examples.zh: 空氣清淨機能高效過濾 PM2.5 等空氣中微細懸浮顆粒污染物。

examples.en: Industrial chemical pollutants dumped illegally into the river poisoned thousands of wild fish.
examples.zh: 不肖業者將未經處理的工業化學污染物惡意偷排入河川，造成下游數以萬計的野生魚類暴斃。

examples.en: Stricter vehicle inspection policies help eliminate harmful exhaust pollutants from city streets.
examples.zh: 嚴格落實汽機車定期排氣檢驗制度，有助於從都會大街小巷中根除刺鼻有害的尾氣污染物。

examples.en: Environmental education teaches youth to respect fragile mountain ecology.
examples.zh: 環境教育教導青年學子懂得發自內心尊重脆弱珍貴的高山自然生態。

examples.en: Building an artificial concrete embankment severely disrupted the river's native wetland ecology.
examples.zh: 盲目興建筆直的水泥三面光防洪護岸工程，嚴重摧毀並瓦解了原本生機盎然的河川濕地生態。

examples.en: She pursued a graduate degree at university to specialize in tropical marine ecology.
examples.zh: 她在知名大學研究所深造攻讀碩士學位，專門深入鑽研亞熱帶熱帶海洋生態學領域。

words.definition: 生態的；符合生態保護的

examples.en: Building wildlife overpasses minimizes the ecological footprint of highways.
examples.zh: 興建跨越公路的野生動物生態通道能將高速公路的生態干擾降至最低。

examples.en: The wetland restoration project succeeded in restoring natural ecological balance to the tidal estuary.
examples.zh: 該處沿海濕地復育工程卓有成效，成功讓這座河海交界的感潮河口重獲生機盎然的自然生態平衡。

examples.en: Chemical oil spills at sea cause immediate and long-lasting ecological devastation along nearby shores.
examples.zh: 遠洋貨輪在海上不幸發生的原油洩漏事故，會對鄰近脆弱海岸線帶來立即且難以磨滅的生態浩劫。
